_readme: Minimal solvers.json snippets for external authors.
Copy the entry you need into configs/solvers.json (or a private copy).
Prefer submission_file / submission_dir before subprocess wrappers.

my-kaggle-submission.notes: Point path at your Kaggle-style submission.json, then: python src/run_evaluation.py --solver my-kaggle-submission

my-prediction-dir.notes: One <task_id>.json per task. adapter_type is an alias of adapter.

my-cli-solver.notes: subprocess_cli aliases to subprocess. Speaks stdin/stdout wire contract.
